typeomega.quest.15C00FA8C66E0F43.title: Agriculture
typeomega.quest.15C00FA8C66E0F43.subtitl: Systems: plants that work for you.
typeomega.quest.15C00FA8C66E0F43.desc.2: Agronomica crops grow on &6Crop Sticks&r, cross-breed into new species and drain their soil as they grow. They give fibre, oil, latex and biomass: the raw stuff of rope, fuel, rubber and ethanol.
typeomega.quest.15C00FA8C66E0F43.desc.4: This chapter runs next to the tiers. Each quest names the tier it needs, so come back whenever a new machine opens a step.
typeomega.quest.79D264DC2DF604DE.title: Crop Sticks
typeomega.quest.79D264DC2DF604DE.desc.0: Till the soil and put &6Crop Sticks&r on the farmland. A seed goes on the sticks, never straight in the ground.
typeomega.quest.79D264DC2DF604DE.desc.2: &aSticks on sticks&r make a cross: that is where new plants are born.
typeomega.quest.5C6E1876A86071AF.title: Wild Seeds
typeomega.quest.5C6E1876A86071AF.desc.0: Breaking grass has a &e3%&r chance to drop &6Hemp&r or &6Rapeseed&r seeds. Ten minutes in a meadow is usually enough.
typeomega.quest.280C95B44BE970BE.title: Hemp
typeomega.quest.280C95B44BE970BE.desc.0: A ripe plant gives its harvest with a right click and drops back to stage one. &6Hemp Fiber&r becomes string and rope; nobody here will ask what else you thought it was for.
typeomega.quest.2CF80B31D06F2D33.title: Rapeseed
typeomega.quest.2CF80B31D06F2D33.desc.0: Rapeseed gives &6Oily Seeds&r, ten times the oil of a wheat seed. Squeeze them in the Extractor.
typeomega.quest.61CDEB8D78DFB807.title: Seed Oil
typeomega.quest.61CDEB8D78DFB807.desc.0: &e100 mB&r of &6Seed Oil&r per Oily Seed, and the Steam Extractor is enough for it.
typeomega.quest.690F090EAB32DC94.title: Oil in the Boiler
typeomega.quest.690F090EAB32DC94.subtitl: An early fuel, not a better one.
typeomega.quest.690F090EAB32DC94.desc.0: Seed Oil burns in a liquid boiler like Creosote: &e250 mB&r for 17.5 seconds. It is a fuel you can farm instead of dig.
typeomega.quest.6D5D193145CB0911.title: Tired Soil
typeomega.quest.6D5D193145CB0911.desc.0: Each plot starts with &e24&r Nitrogen, Phosphorus and Potassium, and each crop eats its own mix. When the soil runs out the plant stops growing.
typeomega.quest.6D5D193145CB0911.desc.2: Hand-made fertilisers come from bone meal: with rotten flesh (&6N&r), more bone meal (&6P&r) or charcoal or ash (&6K&r).
typeomega.quest.5C0076AE44C3EB29.title: NPK by Hand
typeomega.quest.5C0076AE44C3EB29.desc.0: One of each in a crafting grid gives a single &6NPK Fertiliser&r. It works, but the Mixer in MV makes three per batch from real chemistry.
typeomega.quest.540A418CDBD31773.title: Compost Barrel
typeomega.quest.540A418CDBD31773.desc.0: Dark oak and a slab. Drop plant scraps in the barrel and wait: it slowly turns them into &6Compost&r, the cheap fertiliser of the Greenhouse.
typeomega.quest.49E154954764A4ED.title: Compost
typeomega.quest.49E154954764A4ED.desc.0: Collect the &6Compost&r from the barrel. Two of them feed one Greenhouse run.
typeomega.quest.40D5BC0F0055731A.title: Cross-Breeding
typeomega.quest.40D5BC0F0055731A.desc.0: Put a &6cross&r of Crop Sticks between two ripe plants and a child grows there. &6Hemp&r next to &6Rapeseed&r can give &6Elephant Grass&r, whose harvest is the &6Biomass Bundle&r.
typeomega.quest.40D5BC0F0055731A.desc.2: The child takes the average of its parents' Growth, Gain and Resistance, give or take a little.
typeomega.quest.3387CEA15F0DDD4E.title: Growth, Gain, Resistance
typeomega.quest.3387CEA15F0DDD4E.desc.0: &6Growth&r makes the plant faster, &6Gain&r gives more per harvest, &6Resistance&r keeps weeds away. They go from &e1&r to &e31&r; above &e20&r each point is worth less. Breed the best two you have, again and again.
typeomega.quest.002D387591CB9B9D.title: Rubber Bush
typeomega.quest.002D387591CB9B9D.desc.0: Cross &6Rapeseed&r with &6Elephant Grass&r for the &6Rubber Bush&r. Its &6Latex&r is rubber that never saw a tree tap.
typeomega.quest.4D49C4B1B20C5EC3.title: Vulcanised Rubber
typeomega.quest.4D49C4B1B20C5EC3.desc.0: Two &6Latex&r and a &6Sulfur Dust&r in the Alloy Smelter give a &6Rubber Bar&r. Dearer than sticky resin, but it grows on a farm.
typeomega.quest.5A8DE80B2B95A82C.title: Biomass
typeomega.quest.5A8DE80B2B95A82C.desc.0: Four &6Biomass Bundles&r and water become &e300 mB&r of &6Biomass&r in the LV Fermenter. Ferment it again for ethanol; the High Voltage bees drink it too.
typeomega.quest.56013617611B005C.title: Seed Analyzer
typeomega.quest.56013617611B005C.desc.0: Reads the Growth, Gain and Resistance of a seed so you breed on purpose instead of by hope. Higher tiers analyse faster.
typeomega.quest.6AE53EA8632C0F32.title: Industrial NPK
typeomega.quest.6AE53EA8632C0F32.desc.0: Urea from &6Ammonia&r and &6Carbon Dioxide&r, monoammonium phosphate from &6Phosphoric Acid&r and &6Ammonia&r, potassium chloride from &6Rock Salt&r. The Mixer turns one of each into &e3&r NPK, worth &e35&r of every nutrient.
typeomega.quest.113F593262989A47.title: Greenhouse
typeomega.quest.113F593262989A47.subtitl: Hundreds of plants, one block entity.
typeomega.quest.113F593262989A47.desc.0: The GTNA &6Greenhouse&r needs open sky above its glass roof: dim light slows it. One seed of the crop stays in the input bus as a catalyst; &e1&r NPK and &e1,000 mB&r of water give &e8&r of its harvest every 30 seconds. Compost works too, &e2&r per run for &e6&r.
typeomega.quest.4C222A05EE2D18AE.title: Harvest by the Stack
typeomega.quest.4C222A05EE2D18AE.desc.0: A stack of fibre without a single right click. Feed the Greenhouse from the Mixer and the barrels, and its output into the Brewery.
typeomega.quest.72AB8F349180CB28.title: HV Seed Analyzer
typeomega.quest.72AB8F349180CB28.desc.0: The same reading in a fraction of the time, for breeding programs that never stop.
typeomega.quest.534EA0EFEFEF196A.title: Bees
typeomega.quest.534EA0EFEFEF196A.desc.0: No hives grow in the wild here and no bee works for free. A bee goes into a cage, the cage goes into a machine, and the machine makes combs that turn into ore.
typeomega.quest.534EA0EFEFEF196A.desc.2: Everything in this chapter runs on High Voltage. The rarer species wait for Extreme Voltage.
typeomega.quest.41BEC28E3DE99535.title: Bee Cage
typeomega.quest.41BEC28E3DE99535.desc.0: Four &6Steel Rods&r and four &6Iron Bars&r make two cages. Right-click a bee with an empty cage to catch it.
typeomega.quest.219D196510C59DB9.title: A Bee in a Cage
typeomega.quest.219D196510C59DB9.desc.0: Ordinary bees still live in &6Bee Nests&r on oak and birch trees near flowers. Catch one: every metal species starts from a wild bee.
typeomega.quest.57A6FBE224B5D911.title: Honey Bottle
typeomega.quest.57A6FBE224B5D911.desc.0: A glass bottle on a full nest. Calm the bees with a campfire under it first.
typeomega.quest.2C61BAEEE679316E.title: Biomass for Bees
typeomega.quest.2C61BAEEE679316E.desc.0: &e1,000 mB&r of &6Biomass&r per new bee. The LV Fermenter makes it from plants; Elephant Grass from the Agriculture chapter is the best feed.
typeomega.quest.7B40B3F427F9CA07.title: Metal Bee
typeomega.quest.7B40B3F427F9CA07.subtitl: Four blocks of metal and a lot of biomass.
typeomega.quest.7B40B3F427F9CA07.desc.0: In an HV &6Chemical Reactor&r: a caged wild bee, &e4&r blocks of the metal and &e1,000 mB&r of Biomass give a caged metal bee.
typeomega.quest.6C8989C00FB54110.title: Industrial Apiary
typeomega.quest.6C8989C00FB54110.subtitl: A hive with a power cable.
typeomega.quest.6C8989C00FB54110.desc.0: The caged bee sits in the input as a catalyst and is never used up. With &e100 mB&r of water it makes &e2&r combs every &e20&r seconds at HV, faster with overclocks.
typeomega.quest.1D7DEEAD4BE44447.title: Metal Comb
typeomega.quest.1D7DEEAD4BE44447.desc.0: Each species makes its own comb. Two ways to open it, one of them much better.
typeomega.quest.1136E33E3FD99DE1.title: The Lazy Way
typeomega.quest.1136E33E3FD99DE1.desc.0: A &6Centrifuge&r turns a comb into a single &6Small Dust&r. It works, and it wastes three quarters of the comb.
typeomega.quest.21AD28D820DFECB8.title: Comb Leaching
typeomega.quest.21AD28D820DFECB8.desc.0: &e4&r combs and &e384 mB&r of &6Hydrochloric Acid&r in the Chemical Reactor give &e4&r &6Purified Ore&r of the metal, straight into your ore line with all its byproducts. This is how GTNH bees pay for themselves.
typeomega.quest.21AD28D820DFECB8.desc.2: &o&7Zinc has no ore in GregTech, so zinc combs only go through the Centrifuge.&r
typeomega.quest.0283F4777ECE4253.title: Honey Treat
typeomega.quest.0283F4777ECE4253.desc.0: A &6Honey Bottle&r, two &6Wheat&r and &6Sugar&r in the Mixer give &e4&r treats and the bottle back.
typeomega.quest.4D5FE0F95AD07F5E.title: Mutation Chamber
typeomega.quest.4D5FE0F95AD07F5E.desc.0: Two caged parents (kept), a caged wild bee, &e4&r Honey Treats and &e2&r blocks of the metal give the new species every time. No random rolls.
typeomega.quest.4D5FE0F95AD07F5E.desc.2: &o&7The chamber is HV; the species it makes need Extreme Voltage power.&r
typeomega.quest.3D8102E26BB79B9D.title: Species of Extreme Voltage
typeomega.quest.3D8102E26BB79B9D.desc.0: &6Titanium&r = Iron + Aluminium · &6Tungsten&r = Titanium + Tin · &6Molybdenum&r = Copper + Lead · &6Redstone&r = Copper + Gold · &6Lapis&r = Aluminium + Silver.
typeomega.quest.3D8102E26BB79B9D.desc.2: Their chamber run, their apiary and their combs all need EV power.
typeomega.quest.4ACCC233513F88B0.title: Multiblock Goals
typeomega.quest.4ACCC233513F88B0.desc.0: A tracker of every multiblock in the pack, the way the GTNH book keeps its Multiblock Goals. Many of them can be built earlier than their row says if you find the parts; check back often.
typeomega.quest.4ACCC233513F88B0.desc.2: Rows go down by tier and open with the machine hull of that tier. Columns, left to right: Steam and Bricks, Furnaces and Metals, Chemistry, Ores and Mining, Processing and Assembly, Power, Farming and Life, Storage and Data, Space, Wonders and Oddities.

typeomega.quest.1C80807B0037B387.title: How to Read the Book
typeomega.quest.1C80807B0037B387.subtitl: A central route with useful side branches.
typeomega.quest.1C80807B0037B387.desc.0: In each chapter the lines between quests are the main route: follow them from one quest to the next. Connected side quests offer supplies, convenience features and preparation for later machines.
typeomega.quest.1C80807B0037B387.desc.2: A line points from a prerequisite to the quest it unlocks. A quest with several prerequisites needs all of them. The information quests in this chapter can be read right away.
typeomega.quest.1C80807B0037B387.desc.4: Checkmark tasks are manual acknowledgements. Item tasks require the pictured items; rewards must be claimed separately. Convenience commands are optional and only run when you claim their rewards.
typeomega.quest.4EB24270ABDDBEB7.title: Before You Begin
typeomega.quest.4EB24270ABDDBEB7.subtitl: A safe workshop and a few useful controls.
typeomega.quest.4EB24270ABDDBEB7.desc.0: Set up a safe place for your workshop, with storage, lighting and room to expand. Keep water and a renewable supply of wood close by.
typeomega.quest.4EB24270ABDDBEB7.desc.2: Check your Controls menu for conflicting key bindings, especially the quest book, recipe browser and map. These mods share many keys by default.
typeomega.quest.4EB24270ABDDBEB7.desc.4: Item tasks in this chapter detect items in your inventory without consuming them. Collecting a Creosote Bucket also uses normal inventory detection.
typeomega.quest.13B25D31A4A94152.title: About the Pack
typeomega.quest.13B25D31A4A94152.desc.0: GTCEu Modern provides the foundation of the factory. TypeOmega Core and GregTech Nexus Addon add the materials, machines and larger systems used by Type Omega.
typeomega.quest.13B25D31A4A94152.desc.2: The campaign follows Start, Steam, LV and the higher voltage tiers. This chapter prepares your first workshop; it does not require electricity.
typeomega.quest.13B25D31A4A94152.desc.4: The item and recipe browser is your reference for exact ingredients and machine recipes. Search an item and open its recipes or uses whenever a quest introduces something new.
typeomega.quest.48ED4F35ECCFD529.title: Welcome to Type Omega
typeomega.quest.48ED4F35ECCFD529.subtitl: From a small workshop to an infinite factory.
typeomega.quest.48ED4F35ECCFD529.desc.0: Welcome to Type Omega! Your journey begins with a workbench, a furnace and a handful of ores, then grows into a factory powered by steam and electricity.
typeomega.quest.48ED4F35ECCFD529.desc.2: Start with the First Fire chapter and follow the lines from quest to quest. Side branches introduce useful supplies, tools and building aids. Open a quest to read its instructions; hover over a task or reward to see the item it uses.
typeomega.quest.48ED4F35ECCFD529.desc.4: Check this task and claim your Starting Kit next to it.
typeomega.quest.290D8F8D57B5FA44.title: Room for a Factory
typeomega.quest.290D8F8D57B5FA44.subtitl: Building supplies for a growing workshop.
typeomega.quest.290D8F8D57B5FA44.desc.0: Your factory will need more space than a small shelter. Plan a flat work area with room for storage, machines, pipes and future expansions.
typeomega.quest.290D8F8D57B5FA44.desc.2: Claim the Platform Builder, Industrial Platform and construction supplies. Use the Construction Wand and its Angel Core to help place blocks; check their tooltips and key bindings before building.
typeomega.quest.290D8F8D57B5FA44.desc.4: The Personal Space portal opens your own dimension: an empty, flat world (configurable: void, superflat, layers) where you can build the factory without terrain in the way. Place it, then right-click it to set the dimension up.
typeomega.quest.290D8F8D57B5FA44.desc.6: This is an optional building kit. Take the space to plan your workshop, then acknowledge the task to collect it.
typeomega.quest.79F9D0A994CF9EDB.title: Freeze Daylight
typeomega.quest.79F9D0A994CF9EDB.subtitl: Keep the world at its current time of day.
typeomega.quest.79F9D0A994CF9EDB.desc.0: Optional world setting. Claiming this reward disables the daylight cycle and freezes the current time of day; it does not set the time to noon.
typeomega.quest.79F9D0A994CF9EDB.desc.2: This changes the whole world, including other players. To restore the cycle, an operator can run /gamerule doDaylightCycle true. The quest can be repeated if you need to apply it again.
typeomega.quest.4B0F76331F09E588.title: Freeze Weather
typeomega.quest.4B0F76331F09E588.subtitl: Keep the current weather from changing.
typeomega.quest.4B0F76331F09E588.desc.0: Optional world setting. Claiming this reward disables the weather cycle and keeps the current weather. It does not clear rain that is already falling.
typeomega.quest.4B0F76331F09E588.desc.2: This changes the whole world, including other players. To restore normal weather changes, an operator can run /gamerule doWeatherCycle true. The quest can be repeated.
typeomega.quest.75F8535E4B2326CE.title: Night Vision
typeomega.quest.75F8535E4B2326CE.subtitl: Light up your view of the underground.
typeomega.quest.75F8535E4B2326CE.desc.0: Optional personal convenience. Claim the reward to receive Night Vision with an infinite duration, making caves and unlit areas easier to see.
typeomega.quest.75F8535E4B2326CE.desc.2: The effect is applied to the player claiming the reward. Milk, death or another effect-removal mechanic can remove it; repeat this quest to apply it again. Night Vision does not stop hostile mobs from spawning.
typeomega.quest.4C58C4CD61D5370D.title: Community and Wiki
typeomega.quest.4C58C4CD61D5370D.desc.0: The pack's Discord is &6discord.gg/TW5vugknk5&r: questions, bug reports and playtesting.
typeomega.quest.4C58C4CD61D5370D.desc.2: The developer docs (GitHub: Type-Omega/TypeOmega-Dev-Doc) explain the tiers, the systems and every design decision.
typeomega.quest.76593A77A7CEB2F3.title: Off to Work
typeomega.quest.76593A77A7CEB2F3.desc.0: That is everything you need to know before the first tree. The First Fire chapter (0.0) takes you from a campfire to your first Bronze, one step at a time.
typeomega.quest.097B60D5955D7CF7.title: Finding Recipes (EMI)
typeomega.quest.097B60D5955D7CF7.subtitl: R for recipes, U for uses.
typeomega.quest.097B60D5955D7CF7.desc.0: Hover over any item and press &6R&r to see how it is made or &6U&r to see what it is used in. &6A&r adds it to your favourites on the left.
typeomega.quest.097B60D5955D7CF7.desc.2: In a recipe, the &6+&r button fills the crafting grid from your inventory. On a multiblock controller, the first tab shows the whole structure, layer by layer.
typeomega.quest.1F33FD31AC3A4F22.title: Crafting Chain
typeomega.quest.1F33FD31AC3A4F22.subtitl: Every step of a recipe at once.
typeomega.quest.1F33FD31AC3A4F22.desc.0: Crafting Chain crafts an item &6and every intermediate step&r with one key, from what is in your inventory and the chests next to a Crafting Station. When something is missing it says exactly what.
typeomega.quest.1F33FD31AC3A4F22.desc.2: Check its key in Controls; it starts unbound if another mod already uses it.
typeomega.quest.79C83BFB96453D45.title: Maps and Claims
typeomega.quest.79C83BFB96453D45.desc.0: The minimap in the corner and the full map (&6M&r) are Xaero's. Add a waypoint at your base and at every ore vein you find.
typeomega.quest.79C83BFB96453D45.desc.2: On a server, claim your base with FTB Chunks from the map so nobody breaks it, and force-load the chunks your machines need to keep running.
typeomega.quest.4AB61B15543297E5.title: Starting Kit
typeomega.quest.4AB61B15543297E5.desc.0: Tools of the age: steel, built to last the Steam Age.
typeomega.quest.4FD105EEE01075DA.title: Mining Kit
typeomega.quest.4FD105EEE01075DA.desc.0: A steel pickaxe with Fortune III, Unbreaking III and Efficiency III, and a Steel Mining Hammer for 3 x 3 tunnels. Fortune multiplies the raw ore of every GregTech ore, as it does in vanilla.
